## Valid Inputs

### Search by Phone (`input.ant-input[type="tel"][placeholder="Search by Phone"]`)

Per BRD §6 Rule 16 — substring match on `User.phone` only.

| Field | Valid Values | Notes |
|-------|-------------|-------|
| Phone (full) | Any 10-digit numeric string matching a known UAT buyer (e.g. `9876543210`) | Test fixture must be seeded |
| Phone (substring) | Any 3+ digit numeric substring of a known buyer phone (e.g. `987654`) | Substring match behavior |

### Filter — Allocation Status (`allotmentStatus` API param)

Per BRD §6 Rule 19. Comma-separated multi-select allowed.

| UI Label | API Value |
|----------|-----------|
| Registered | `registered` |
| Booked Online | `booked_online` |
| Booked Offline | `booked_offline` |
| Waitlisted | `waitlisted` |
| Cancelled/Refunded | `refunded` |
| Alloted | `alloted` |

### Filter — Payment (`paymentStatus` API param)

Case-sensitive per BRD §6 Rule 19.

| UI Label | API Value |
|----------|-----------|
| Paid | `Paid` |
| Pending | `Pending` |

### Filter — KYC / Process Status (`kycStatus` API param)

Case-sensitive per BRD §6 Rule 19.

| UI Label | API Value |
|----------|-----------|
| KYC Completed | `KYC Completed` |
| KYC Pending | `KYC Pending` |

### Filter — Home Loan (`hasHomeLoan` API param)

Per BRD §6 Rule 18 — completion-status only.

| UI Label | API Value | Backend Evaluation |
|----------|-----------|--------------------|
| Yes | `true` | `HomeLoan.status='completed'` |
| No | `false` | `HomeLoan.status IN ('in_progress', NULL)` |

## Invalid / Boundary Inputs

### Search by Phone

Per BRD §6 Rule 16 (CORRECTED 2026-05-21) — these MUST return 0 matches because the OR branches are commented out in source.

| Field | Invalid Value | Expected Result |
|-------|--------------|----------------|
| Phone (name) | `Rajesh` (first name) | 0 rows — empty state (NOT a name search) |
| Phone (last name) | `Kumar` | 0 rows — empty state |
| Phone (registration code) | `GHNG-1000008563` | 0 rows — empty state |
| Phone (confirmation number) | `<TYPE>-BKD` | 0 rows — empty state |
| Phone (unit number) | `2404` | 0 rows — empty state |
| Phone (tower name) | `Crown` | 0 rows — empty state |
| Phone (non-existent) | `0000000000` | 0 rows — empty state, heading "0 Registration Records" |
| Phone (special chars) | `!!@@##` | 0 rows — empty state |
| Phone (empty) | `` (cleared input) | Full record set restored |

### Filter Values (Negative — case sensitivity)

| Field | Invalid Value | Expected Result |
|-------|--------------|----------------|
| paymentStatus | `paid` (lowercase) | API rejects or returns unfiltered (case-sensitive per BRD §6 Rule 19) |
| paymentStatus | `PAID` (uppercase) | Same as above |
| kycStatus | `kyc completed` (lowercase) | Same — case-sensitive |
| allotmentStatus | `Allocated` (wrong term) | Not in accepted list — rejected/ignored |
| allotmentStatus | `allocationStatus` (wrong param name) | Backend ignores; full result returned |

## Pre-conditions

### Authentication
- Admin session active via `automation-repository/fixtures/.auth/admin.json` — generated by `npm run auth:setup`
- If session expired → re-run `auth:setup` before any test

### Data Pre-conditions per TC group

| TC group | Required test data |
|----------|-------------------|
| KPI/UI baseline | None — uses live UAT data |
| Search by Phone | ≥1 known UAT buyer with a stable phone number (seed in test-data fixture) |
| Filter — Allocation Status | ≥1 row per status in (registered, booked_online, booked_offline, waitlisted, refunded) |
| Filter — Payment | ≥1 row with `Paid`, ≥1 with `Pending` |
| Filter — KYC | ≥1 row with KYC Completed, ≥1 with KYC Pending |
| Filter — Home Loan | ≥1 row with HomeLoan.status='completed', ≥1 with in_progress, ≥1 with null |
| Cancel Unit flow (TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_034) | Dedicated test booking with CRM Activity + Mavis cleanup completed externally |
| Cancel Registration flow (TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_036) | Dedicated test registration (no unit allotted) |
| Home Loan Approval (TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_039) | Any row with the action available |
| Cross-module — Active Towers KPI (TC_CUSTOMERS_BIZ_005) | Admin has Config edit access; 1 inactive tower available to toggle |
| Cross-module — Growth Partner (TC_CUSTOMERS_XMOD_052) | Known CP with HV code linked to a registration |
| Cross-module — Payment (TC_CUSTOMERS_XMOD_053) | Known paid registration with payment record |
| Multi-sub registration (TC_CUSTOMERS_BIZ_054) | Buyer with ≥3 sub-registrations (suffix A, B, C) |
| Empty-state (TC_CUSTOMERS_EDGE_055) | None — relies on no-match input |

### Environment
- Base URL: `https://uat-web.xrportal.in`
- Customers URL: `/admin/customers`
- Viewport: 1920×900 (matches visual capture)
- Browser: Chromium (Playwright `--headed --workers=1`)

## Cleanup / Teardown

| TC | Cleanup action |
|----|----------------|
| TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_034 / TC_CUSTOMERS_E2E_049 (Cancel Unit) | **Permanent — no undo per BRD §6 Rule 3.** Use a one-off seeded test booking that is acceptable to destroy. Document the cancellation in test-run notes. |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_036 / TC_CUSTOMERS_E2E_050 (Cancel Registration) | **Permanent — ₹999 refund recorded.** Use a one-off seeded test registration. Reconcile refund in test ledger. |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_039 (Home Loan Approval) | If toggle was switched, switch it back at end of test via the same modal |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_FUNC_040 / TC_CUSTOMERS_FUNC_041 (Download) | Delete downloaded `RegistrationData.xlsx` from local download folder |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_BIZ_005 (Cross-module Config toggle) | After test, toggle the modified tower back to its original state in Config |
| Filter-applied TCs | Click "Reset Filters " button at end of test to restore baseline state |
| Search by Phone TCs | Clear the search input at end of test |

## Browser Network Notes (for API-level assertion)

Per BRD §6 Rule 19 and INDEX.md API/Network Notes:

- Customer list endpoint returns paginated records keyed by composite IDs `GHNG-NNNNNNNNNN-X`
- `globalSearch` param = phone-only substring (per Rule 16)
- Filter dropdowns are server-side — verify outgoing query params:
  - `allotmentStatus` (NOT `allocationStatus`)
  - `paymentStatus` (case-sensitive)
  - `kycStatus` (case-sensitive)
  - `hasHomeLoan=true|false`
- Download triggers `isDownload=1` query param — removes pagination but preserves `where[Op.and]` filter conditions
- KPI endpoint (`adminKpi`) — separate aggregate query, does NOT honor table filters; does NOT include `allotedCount` field (dead code per Rule 17)
- Default `projectId` substitution: UAT = 2, prod = 1 (Backend Gap GAP-DEV-001)
